blocks.orig: Experience the best of Tanzania’s nature, wildlife and beautiful beaches on this 15 Days Tanzania Safari & Zanzibar trip. Spot the black-and-white colobus monkeys in Arusha National Park and herds of up to 300 elephants in Tarangire National Park. Enjoy the overwhelming wildlife and breathtaking scenery of the Serengeti and Ngorongoro Crater before you fly to Zanzibar. What better way to end your safari than unwinding on white-sand beaches surrounded by crystal clear waters?
blocks.html: On this 15 Days Tanzania Safari & Zanzibar trip you see the finest of Tanzania’s wildlife, nature and lovely beaches. Look out for black-and-white colobus monkeys in Arusha National Park, and for elephant herds as large as 300 animals in Tarangire National Park. Take in the abundant wildlife and the spectacular landscapes of the Serengeti and the Ngorongoro Crater, then fly on to Zanzibar. Could there be a better finish to a safari than winding down on white-sand beaches beside crystal clear water?

blocks.orig: This private safari offers you the flexibility to travel at your own pace, exactly the way you like it. You will have a private safari vehicle and guide.
blocks.html: As this safari is private, you can travel at your own pace and shape each day just as you like. A guide and safari vehicle are reserved for you alone.

blocks.orig: Many travelers ask us when the best time is to visit Tanzania. The answer is … there is not one right answer. It depends on what you want to see, where you want to go, your budget and interests. Please find a comprehensive guide on when is the best time to visit Tanzania here.
blocks.html: A question we hear from many travellers is when they should visit Tanzania. Honestly, … no single answer is correct. It comes down to what you hope to see, the places you want to go, your interests and your budget. You can read our detailed guide on the best time to visit Tanzania here.

blocks.orig: Our safaris in Tanzania offer an opportunity to explore the country’s incredible wildlife and stunning landscapes. We specialize in private safaris, which means you have a 4×4 Landcruiser or jeep all to yourselves. You have the flexibility to decide when the safari starts and ends, and our experienced guides can help you make that decision on the day of your adventure. Whether you want to witness the animals at their most active during sunrise and sunset when temperatures are pleasant, or if you fancy ending the day by the pool, it’s entirely up to you. Tanzania’s diverse wildlife is active at various times of the day, so you’ll have plenty of opportunities to spot the animals in action.
blocks.html: With our Tanzania safaris you get the chance to discover the country’s remarkable wildlife and beautiful scenery. Private safaris are our speciality: the 4×4 Landcruiser or jeep is for you and your party only. You choose when each safari day begins and finishes, and on the day itself our experienced guides are happy to help you decide. Would you like to see the animals at their liveliest around sunrise and sunset, when it is pleasantly cool, or would you rather finish the afternoon at the pool? The choice is yours. Since Tanzania’s many species are active at different times of day, you will have lots of chances to watch them in action.

When you plan your Tanzania adventure with us, you’re not just booking a trip; you’re embarking on a personalized experience. We start by understanding your wishes and preferences, and we won’t stop until every aspect of your journey aligns perfectly with your vision. Our team works closely with you to ensure that your entire trip is tailor-made to your satisfaction. And for added convenience, we offer a selection of our most popular Tanzania trips and safaris as a starting point for your consideration.
blocks.html: At Your Tanzania Trip we build your ideal journey together with you. Planning your Tanzania adventure with us means more than reserving a trip; it means setting out on a personal experience. First we get to know your wishes and preferences, and we keep going until every part of the journey matches what you have in mind. Our team stays in close contact with you so that the whole trip is tailor-made to your satisfaction. To make things easier, we also present a selection of our most popular Tanzania trips and safaris that you can use as a starting point.

blocks.orig: Absolutely, Tanzania is renowned as one of the prime destinations to encounter the Big Five. These magnificent creatures—lion, leopard, elephant, rhinoceros, and buffalo—can be observed in their natural habitats, making Tanzania a preferred choice for wildlife enthusiasts.
blocks.html: Yes, definitely. Tanzania is well known as one of the best places to see the Big Five. Lion, leopard, elephant, rhinoceros and buffalo can all be watched in their natural surroundings, which is why so many wildlife lovers choose Tanzania.

blocks.orig: Absolutely, Tanzania is a safe and welcoming destination for travelers. The country offers a hospitable environment, especially in tourist areas like Arusha, and you can explore its beautiful landscapes and wildlife with confidence. Local people are friendly, and safety measures, such as keeping an eye on your belongings, are always advisable, just as you would in any other part of the world. Tanzania’s natural beauty and the warmth of its people make it a fantastic place to visit.
blocks.html: Yes, Tanzania is a safe and welcoming country to travel in. The atmosphere is hospitable, particularly in tourist areas such as Arusha, so you can discover the lovely landscapes and wildlife with peace of mind. People are friendly, and it is always sensible to take ordinary precautions, like watching your belongings, as you would anywhere else in the world. Thanks to its natural beauty and the warmth of its people, Tanzania is a wonderful country to visit.

blocks.orig: As you walk out of Kilimanjaro International Airport, your personal Your Tanzania Trip guide greets you with a big smile: 'Karibu Tanzania - welcome to Tanzania!' The guide takes you straight to your hotel, where you can relax and take in the African atmosphere. The next day your guide takes you on an exclusive, private safari that allows you to travel at your own pace. Enjoy the luxury of your own safari jeep and take the liberty to stop and watch the animals as long as you like!
blocks.html: The moment you leave Kilimanjaro International Airport, your own Your Tanzania Trip guide welcomes you with a broad smile: 'Karibu Tanzania - welcome to Tanzania!' You are driven directly to your hotel to unwind and soak up the African atmosphere. On the following day your guide sets off with you on an exclusive, private safari, so you can travel at a pace that suits you. You have your own safari jeep, and you are free to stop and watch the animals for as long as you want!

blocks.orig: Today is a wonderful relaxing day, that you can spend in whatever way you like. Choose to spend the whole day at the lodge to enjoy the excellent service, sip on refreshing drinks, lounge near the pool, and just engulf yourself in the African vibes surrounding you. Or get to know Arusha through some interesting activities - go for example on a city tour, explore the outskirts of the city by mountain bike, or score your first souvenirs at an exhilarating Maasai market…
blocks.html: Today is a lovely, easy day to fill exactly as you please. You might stay at the lodge all day, enjoying the excellent service, sipping cool drinks, relaxing by the pool and letting the African surroundings sink in. Or you can discover Arusha with some interesting activities - take a city tour, for example, cycle through the outskirts on a mountain bike, or find your first souvenirs at a lively Maasai market…

blocks.orig: Today you will go for your first actual game drive, in Arusha National Park! This park close to Arusha is known for its abundance of tropical birds, the presence of the black and white Colobus monkey and some rare albino baboons. You will probably spot the Colobus monkey and some rare bird species such as the gorgeous Silvery Cheeked Hornbill, and, if you are very lucky, even an albino. The park also has a lake, a few craters, waterfalls, mountains, and beautiful grassy planes.
blocks.html: Today brings your first real game drive, in Arusha National Park! Close to Arusha, this park is famous for its many tropical birds, its black and white Colobus monkeys and a few rare albino baboons. Chances are you will see the Colobus monkey and rare birds like the lovely Silvery Cheeked Hornbill, and with a lot of luck even an albino. You will also find a lake, several craters, waterfalls, mountains and pretty grassy plains in the park.

blocks.orig: Today you can relax at your hotel to enjoy the friendly service, or go out and about through a range of activities! You can for example visit the beautiful Mount Meru waterfalls. A short hike leads you there, after which you can take a refreshing swim in the cold water beneath the waterfall. Have your lunch in these quiet surroundings amidst singing birds and meandering water and try and spot the amazing Colobus monkey or the Silvery Cheeked Hornbill on your way back!
blocks.html: You can stay at your hotel today and enjoy the friendly service, or head out for one of a number of activities! One option is a visit to the lovely Mount Meru waterfalls. You reach them on a short hike, and afterwards you can cool off with a swim in the cold water at the foot of the falls. Eat your lunch in this peaceful setting, with birdsong and winding streams around you, and on the way back keep an eye out for the striking Colobus monkey or the Silvery Cheeked Hornbill!

blocks.orig: Tarangire National Park is well known for its big groups of elephants and the huge amount of giant baobab trees. These trees can live for hundreds of years and are actually a source of water for elephants in the dry season as they have a special technique to draw water from them. Besides, the Tarangire River is the only source of water in the dry season, which is why in this season in Tarangire you can see groups of up to 250 elephants next to many more animals!
blocks.html: Tarangire National Park is famous for its large elephant herds and its many giant baobab trees. These trees can reach an age of hundreds of years, and in the dry season they even supply elephants with water, as the elephants have a particular way of drawing it out of them. In addition, the Tarangire River is the only water source during the dry season, so at that time of year you can see herds of up to 250 elephants in Tarangire, alongside many other animals!

blocks.orig: Serengeti National Park is widely known as the place to go on safari, mainly because of the Great Migration that passes through here. The enormous, stampeding herds are impressive, as are the vast number of predators that live here: over four thousand lions, over 200 cheetahs, a thousand leopards, 3500 hyenas, and hundreds of wild dogs! And of course, plenty of other beautiful animals, which your guide will be delighted to search for together with you. Are you ready for this?
blocks.html: Serengeti National Park has a wide reputation as the place for a safari, mostly thanks to the Great Migration that moves through it. The huge, thundering herds are a striking sight, and so is the number of predators living here: more than four thousand lions, more than 200 cheetahs, a thousand leopards, 3500 hyenas and hundreds of wild dogs! There are of course many other lovely animals too, and your guide will gladly go looking for them with you. Are you ready?

blocks.orig: The famous Ngorongoro Crater is one of Africa's seven natural wonders. The crater was formed two million years ago when a vast volcano erupted. The fertile lava has created a unique ecosystem, now home to the highest concentration of animals found anywhere in Africa! Once in the crater, thousands of animals such as lions, zebras, buffalos and black rhinos surround you, and the views are astounding – you won’t know where to look!
blocks.html: The well-known Ngorongoro Crater counts as one of Africa's seven natural wonders. It came into being two million years ago, when an enormous volcano erupted. The fertile lava produced a unique ecosystem that now holds the highest density of animals anywhere in Africa! Down in the crater you are surrounded by thousands of animals, including lions, zebras, buffalos and black rhinos, and the views are so stunning that you won’t know which way to look!

blocks.orig: Today you fly to the spice island of Zanzibar. Our guide picks you up at the airport and takes you to your hotel. Over the next few days, you can discover white sandy beaches, crystal-clear turquoise waters and vibrant coral reefs. Into culture? Then head to Stone Town and dive into the history of this fascinating little town. Food lovers can also visit the spice plantations and discover the diverse flavours of the delicious local cuisine. A tropical paradise awaits you!
blocks.html: Today you take a flight to Zanzibar, the spice island. At the airport our guide meets you and drives you to your hotel. In the coming days you can explore white sandy beaches, clear turquoise water and colourful coral reefs. Interested in culture? Go to Stone Town and immerse yourself in the history of this intriguing little town. If you love food, you can tour the spice plantations and get to know the varied flavours of the tasty local cuisine. Tropical paradise is waiting for you!

blocks.orig: Ultimate paradise is here: gorgeous, tropical Zanzibar! The clear blue waters of the Indian Ocean and the palm-fringed, white sandy beaches are almost too beautiful to be true. Buy your coconut drink fresh on the beach, spend hours sunbathing or swimming, and taste the delicious Zanzibari food. In the mood for something active? Then explore the beach, ocean, and island through a range of activities! We highly recommend the Safari Blue Cruise or a tour of Stone Town.
blocks.html: Welcome to paradise: beautiful, tropical Zanzibar! With the clear blue Indian Ocean and white sandy beaches lined with palm trees, it can seem almost too lovely to be real. Pick up a fresh coconut drink on the beach, sunbathe or swim for hours, and try the tasty Zanzibari food. Feel like doing something active? You can discover the beach, the ocean and the island with a variety of activities! The Safari Blue Cruise or a Stone Town tour are our warm recommendations.

blocks.orig: The last day! Depending on your flight time, you can relax on the beach or explore the island just a little bit more. Then, make your way to Zanzibar International Airport in time for your flight home. Having second thoughts? It's also possible to extend your holiday to another paradise island, such as Mnemba, Pemba, or Mafia!
blocks.html: Your final day! Depending on when your flight leaves, you can enjoy the beach or see a little more of the island. After that, travel to Zanzibar International Airport in good time for your flight home. Not ready to leave yet? You can also extend your holiday on another paradise island, for example Mnemba, Pemba or Mafia!
